age_minimum.quote: The applicant has attained the age of twenty-one years.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant does not have a substance use disorder, as defined in section 27-81-102, or has not habitually or excessively used or abused alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances

accrediting_body.quote: accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization that is recognized or approved by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or the United States secretary of education

exams.name: Standardized national examination approved by the board
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed a standardized national examination approved by the board that tests the qualifications of the applicant to practice optometry in the state.

exams.quote: the applicant has satisfied the requirements of section 12-275-113 or equivalent requirements approved by the board, including passing a standardized national examination in the treatment and management of ocular disease.

required.quote: the board shall require that each optometrist seeking to renew a license shall have completed twenty-four hours of board-approved continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: each optometrist seeking to renew a license shall have completed twenty-four hours of board-approved continuing education.

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of optometry to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice optometry in this state except those who are duly licensed optometrists pursuant to the provisions of this article 275.

credential_type.quote: Each person who makes a passing grade on the practical and clinical examination and who is otherwise qualified shall be granted a license signed by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice optometry in this state except those who are duly licensed optometrists pursuant to the provisions of this article 275.

title_protection.quote: No other person shall use the title "optometrist", "O.D.", "doctor of optometry", or any other word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is licensed to practice optometry in this state.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice optometry without an active license issued under this article 275 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceiving or attempting to deceive the board or its agents with reference to any proper matter under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deceiving or attempting to deceive the board or its agents with reference to any proper matter under investigation by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or circulating fraudulent, false, deceitful, or misleading claims relating to optometry services or ophthalmic materials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or circulating, directly or indirectly, any fraudulent, false, deceitful, or misleading claims or statements relating to optometry services or ophthalmic materials or devices;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or offering compensation to any person as an inducement to secure assistance in soliciting patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing or offering compensation or merchandise of value to any salesperson, runner, patient, or other person as an inducement to secure his or her services or assistance in the solicitation of patronage

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license or in taking any examination provided for in this article 275;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or any controlled substance as defined in section 18-18-102 (5);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disobeying the lawful rule or order of the board or its officers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disobeying the lawful rule or order of the board or its officers;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry while one's license is suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry while one's license is suspended;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry as the partner, agent, or employee of or in joint venture with any proprietor or unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry as the partner, agent, or employee of or in joint venture or arrangement with any proprietor or with any person who does not hold a license to practice optometry within this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: An act or omission constituting grossly negligent optometry practice or two or more acts failing to meet generally accepted standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An act or omission constituting grossly negligent optometry practice or two or more acts or omissions that fail to meet generally accepted standards of optometry practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sharing professional fees with any person who sends or refers patients, except with associated licensed optometrists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sharing any professional fees with any person, partnership, or corporation that sends or refers patients to him or her, except with licensed optometrists with whom he or she may be associated in practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness or condition that renders an optometrist unable to treat with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to: Notify the board, in a manner and within a period determined by the board, of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral, mental health, or substance use disorder that renders an optometrist unable to treat with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to refer a patient to the appropriate health-care practitioner when services required are beyond the optometrist's scope
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to refer a patient to the appropriate health-care practitioner when the services required by the patient are beyond the scope of competency of the optometrist or the scope of practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not licensed to practice optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, in the practice of optometry, any person not licensed to practice optometry as defined under this article 275 or any person whose license to practice is suspended;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interfering with the free choice of any person selecting a physician or other health-care practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interfering with the free choice of any person selecting a physician or other health-care practitioner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any disciplinary action against a licensee in another state or country that would constitute unprofessional conduct in Colorado
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action against a licensee to practice optometry in another state or country, which action shall be deemed to be prima facie evidence of unprofessional conduct if the grounds for the disciplinary action would be unprofessional conduct or otherwise constitute a violation of any provision of this article 275;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a malpractice final judgment or settlement within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board of a malpractice final judgment or settlement within thirty days;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of care whether or not actual injury to a patient is established
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of care whether or not actual injury to a patient is established;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or acceptance of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or the acceptance of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, or a plea resulting in a deferred sentence to a felony;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that a noncorrectable condition can be permanently corrected
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing that a noncorrectable condition can be permanently corrected;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making any false or fraudulent statement in connection with the practice of optometry, including falsifying patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any false or fraudulent statement, written or oral, in connection with the practice of optometry, including falsifying or making incorrect essential entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that is likely to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct that is likely to deceive or defraud the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligent malpractice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of abuse of health insurance or advertising to perform prohibited acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119; or Advertising through newspapers, magazines, circulars, direct mail, directories, radio, television, or otherwise that the licensee will perform any act prohibited by section 18-13-119 (3);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any prescription drug or controlled substance other than in the course of legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any prescription drug, as defined in section 12-280-103 (42), or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly ordering or performing demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or administering unnecessary treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly ordering or performing demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies that lack clinical justification; Administering treatment that is demonstrably unnecessary and lacks clinical justification;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any optometrist known to have violated any provisions of this article
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any optometrist known to have violated or, upon information or belief, believed to have violated any of the provisions of this article 275;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any surrender of a license or adverse action taken by another licensing agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any surrender of a license to, or any adverse action taken against a licensee by another licensing agency in another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient while a patient-optometrist relationship exists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient while a patient-optometrist relationship exists.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a patient with copies of patient medical records as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide a patient with copies of patient medical records as required by section 25-1-802;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a patient with a valid written contact lens prescription as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide a patient with a valid written contact lens prescription as required by section 12-275-119 (3);

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this article 275 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this article 275 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of education and training prescribed by rules adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the scope of education and training prescribed by rules adopted by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint pursuant to section 12-275-122 (1)(b).

definition_quote.value: the 'practice of optometry' means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the vision system, eyes, and adjacent and associated structures, including the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease
definition_quote.quote: the "practice of optometry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the vision system, eyes, and adjacent and associated structures, including the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease

value: dilation and irrigation of lacrimal system
debridement and removal of corneal epithelium
local anesthetic for eyelid lesion treatment
removal and biopsy of eyelid lesions
laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty
methods_authorized.quote: The following are part of the practice of optometry: The removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye or its appendages; Postoperative care; The treatment of anterior uveitis; The treatment of glaucoma with all topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs; Epilation; Dilation and irrigation of the lacrimal system; Punctal plug insertion and removal; Anterior corneal puncture; Corneal scraping for cultures; Debridement of corneal epithelium; Removal of corneal epithelium; Injections for the treatment of conditions or diseases of the eye or eyelid; The use of a local anesthetic in conjunction with the primary treatment of an eyelid lesion; Removal and biopsy of eyelid lesions; Incision and curettage of a chalazion; Simple repair of an eyelid laceration; Corneal cross-linking; and Laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty.

drug_authority.value: May prescribe or use prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease; may not use schedule I or II narcotics except hydrocodone combination drugs; may use epinephrine auto-injector for anaphylaxis
drug_authority.quote: prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease

surgery_prohibited.quote: The "practice of optometry" does not include: Surgery of or injections into the globe, orbit, eyelids, or ocular adnexa. "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.

surgery_definition.value: any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: The removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye or its appendages;

laser_procedures_authorized.quote: Laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty.

value: dilation and irrigation of the lacrimal system
injections for treatment of conditions or diseases of the eye or eyelid (excluding intraocular injections penetrating the globe)
use of local anesthetic in conjunction with primary treatment of an eyelid lesion
removal and biopsy of eyelid lesions without characteristics of malignancy (excluding lesions involving eyelid margin or larger than 5mm)
incision and curettage of a chalazion
simple repair of eyelid laceration no larger than 2.5 cm and no deeper than orbicularis muscle
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Epilation; Dilation and irrigation of the lacrimal system; Punctal plug insertion and removal; Anterior corneal puncture; Corneal scraping for cultures; Debridement of corneal epithelium; Removal of corneal epithelium; Injections for the treatment of conditions or diseases of the eye or eyelid, excluding intraocular injections penetrating the globe; The use of a local anesthetic in conjunction with the primary treatment of an eyelid lesion; Removal and biopsy of eyelid lesions without characteristics or obvious signs of malignancy, excluding lesions involving the eyelid margin or larger than five millimeters in size; Incision and curettage of a chalazion; Simple repair of an eyelid laceration no larger than two and one-half centimeters and no deeper than the orbicularis muscle and not involving the eyelid margin or lacrimal drainage structures; Corneal cross-linking;

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: The treatment of glaucoma with all topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs;

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: the use of an epinephrine auto-injector to counteract anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation

Schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs authorized
Schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances authorized for ocular disease
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The use of schedule I or II narcotics, except for hydrocodone combination drugs

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months
opioid_prescription_day_limit.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 30 - Provisions Applicable to Health-Care Profession

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The treatment of glaucoma with all topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs;

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: A licensed optometrist shall not use prescription or nonprescription drugs for treatment of eye disease or disorder or for any therapeutic purpose unless he or she is a therapeutic optometrist.

dea_registration_required.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.
dea_registration_required.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 30 - Provisions Applicable to Health-Care Profession

tiered_license_types.quote: A therapeutic optometrist is an optometrist licensed pursuant to this article 275 who meets the requirements of section 12-275-113 (2) and (4).

specialty_certification_types.quote: A therapeutic optometrist is an optometrist licensed pursuant to this article 275 who meets the requirements of section 12-275-113 (2) and (4). A licensed optometrist shall not use prescription or nonprescription drugs for treatment of eye disease or disorder or for any therapeutic purpose unless he or she is a therapeutic optometrist.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: Successful completion, by attendance and examination, of at least sixty classroom hours of study in ocular pharmacology, clinical pharmacology, therapeutics, and anterior segment disease; and successful completion by attendance and examination of at least sixty hours of approved supervised clinical training

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: successful completion by attendance and examination of at least sixty hours of approved supervised clinical training in the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of conditions of the human eye and its appendages.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Failing to refer a patient to the appropriate health-care practitioner when the services required by the patient are beyond the scope of competency of the optometrist or the scope of practice of optometry;

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: Postoperative care in the following situations: With referral from a physician; If ninety days have expired after the surgery unless the physician justifies medically indicated reasons for extending the postoperative period; and If the patient has been released by the physician;

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: The board may enter into an agreement in accordance with section 12-30-108 with an optometrist whose practice is or may be affected by a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral or mental health disorder

retired_license_status_available.quote: A person licensed to practice optometry pursuant to this article 275 may apply to the board for volunteer licensure status.
